title: Casio Vintage Digital Unisex Watch A158WEM-3DF
description:
An updated take on a favorite classic — the ever-popular, easy-to-use A158 goes stylishly elegant with a fine-woven mesh band. Treated with a specialized pressing process that adds depth and dimension, the mesh band delivers a refined, vintage look and a totally comfortable fit for your wrist.

Choose a dial in dark green or light gray. The silver-colored case and contrasting dial present an understated color scheme that adds a simple yet original touch to your style. These classic designs highlight the beauty of metal mesh for a refined and elegant presence all their own.
features: Approx. battery life: 7 years on CR2016
